f.re: 1. Commercial and recreational fishing are prohibited. 2. It is unlawful to introduce any form of plant or animal life into this area. 3. It is unlawful to possess any fishing gear while in this area. 4. No motorized vessel may be operated, moored, or anchored in this area.
